epics.title: Fix Deliverable Readiness Stagnation Bug
epics.jtbd: When the project observer calculates deliverable readiness, I want the metric to accurately reflect resolved items, so that the stagnation warning is resolved and true progress is tracked.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce deliverable readiness calculation errors from 1 to 0
requirements: R1: Identify and patch the bug in the existing codebase that causes the deliverable readiness ratio to stagnate at ~67% when items are resolved.

slices.title: Patch deliverable readiness tracking logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to patch the calculation logic, so that the metric correctly updates when items are resolved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the deliverable readiness ratio is 67%,
When new items are resolved in the cycle,
Then the ratio calculates correctly based on the new resolved items.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce calculation logic bugs from 1 to 0

slices.title: Verify deliverable readiness metric resolution
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to verify the readiness calculation across the test pyramid, so that future stagnation regressions are prevented.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the tracking patch is deployed,
When tests simulate a deliverable resolution,
Then the reported readiness metric correctly increases above 67%.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase test coverage for metric updates from 0 to 1
